title.en: Start an anonymous Daily Sprint from Home
title.zh: 首页直接开始匿名今日速成

purpose.en: Open the same language-and-time Sprint picker directly from the Home task image, let signed-out learners finish the five-skill Beginner experience without database writes, and invite them to create an account or sign in only after completion.
purpose.zh: 首页今日任务图片直接打开同一套语言与时长弹窗，让未登录学习者完成 Beginner 五项速成且不写数据库，结束后再邀请注册或登录。

en: Reuse one accessible Daily Sprint picker for the Home task image and the Play activity tile.
Keep all twelve learning languages, 5/10/15/20-minute choices, and the default 10-minute selection identical in both entry points.
Allow only official Open Beginner Sprint plans to load without sign-in; anonymous start reads published vocabulary but creates no Sprint run row.
Grade the anonymous result locally, omit rankings and persistence claims, then show localized Create account and Sign in actions.
Record the user's standing authorization for scheduled QA to use the dedicated test identity and newest Gmail verification code without repeating the permission question.
zh: 首页今日任务图片与 Play 玩法卡复用同一个可访问的今日速成弹窗。
两个入口均提供相同的十二种学习语言、5/10/15/20 分钟选择，并默认 10 分钟。
仅官方公开 Beginner 速成可免登录读取；匿名开始只读取已发布词库，不创建速成运行记录。
匿名成绩仅在本页计算，不显示排行榜或保存承诺；结束后显示本地化注册和登录按钮。
记录用户对定时 QA 使用专用测试身份及 Gmail 最新验证码的长期授权，不再重复询问。

en: Replace the Home task navigation link with the shared picker trigger while preserving the image-card visual and keyboard semantics.
Add a narrowly scoped public Beginner Sprint access path; signed-in Play attempts still persist server-graded scores, while signed-out attempts never call the completion write endpoint.
Update the 3 AM recovery contract for the Home overlay behavior and the user's explicit standing test-login authorization.
zh: 把首页今日任务链接替换为共享弹窗触发器，同时保留图片卡视觉与键盘操作语义。
增加严格限定的公开 Beginner 速成入口：登录用户仍保存服务器评分，未登录用户绝不调用完成写入接口。
更新凌晨 3 点恢复合同，覆盖首页浮层行为及用户明确授予的测试登录长期授权。

en: TypeScript, changed-file ESLint, sensitive-data scan, and the production build pass.
The full repository suite passes 327/327 tests, including anonymous access boundaries, shared picker behavior, and local-only completion.
WebKit runtime layout passes 260/260 checks across 26 routes, Chinese and English, and five phone, iPad, and desktop viewports.
Shared policy, architecture, base-feature consistency, and all 11 SmartLingo shared contracts pass.
zh: TypeScript、本次文件 ESLint、敏感数据扫描和正式构建通过。
全仓 327/327 项测试通过，包括匿名访问边界、共享弹窗和仅本地完成成绩。
WebKit 运行布局通过 260/260 项：26 个路由、中英文和 5 种手机、iPad、桌面尺寸。
共享政策、架构、基础功能一致性及 SmartLingo 全部 11 项共享合同通过。

en: Automated production browser QA cannot provide a real human speech sample; it verifies the anonymous flow through the microphone-ready state without inventing a pronunciation score.
zh: 自动正式站浏览器验收无法提供真人语音样本；它会把匿名流程验证到麦克风就绪状态，但不会伪造发音成绩。

en: This is a SmartLingo-specific learning conversion flow. It does not change other portfolio sites or their authentication and persistence boundaries.
zh: 这是 SmartLingo 专属学习转化流程，不改变其他站点及其登录与数据持久化边界。
